lead.headline: RA Capital filed as director at 21 companies in 2024, OrbiMed 16, Baker Bros 13; eight firms drive biotech's lead
lead.number: Investment firms filed as director at 91 of 708 biotechs (12.9%) vs 24 of 372 software companies (6.5%) in 2024; without eight firms, biotech is below software in 2022, 2023 and 2024.
lead.watch_out: Eight firms carry the whole biotech-vs-software gap, so the "sector" test is really a test of RA, OrbiMed and Baker Bros; a 4-year window cuts the gap to 1.4x and counting 10% owners to 1.25x.
